answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs), such as GPT-3, Gemini, and Claude 3, have revolutionized natural language processing and showcased impressive near-human-level text generation capabilities. These advanced LLMs facilitate the creation of flexible and contextually coherent text across diverse genres for text-based steganography... Alice employs LLMs to generate steganographic texts (stegotexts) or watermarked texts...

answer_2.quote: Bits per token (BPT) is a fundamental metric in linguistic steganography... Perplexity (PPL) assesses the quality and fluency of the generated text. KL divergence (KLD) between modified and original candidate pools quantifies statistical disparities... Steganalysis accuracy (ACC) indicates the ability to invalidate detection... watermark strengths... AU-ROC value...
